name: Early American Adventure Camp
description_short: A full-day history camp for ages 8-12, run by the Noah Webster House museum with West Hartford's Westmoor Park. Campers try 18th-century chores, games, and crafts, and at Westmoor Park they care for barnyard animals and tend a vegetable garden.

warnings: This page covers the 2026 season, and all of its dates (July 2026) are already past as of 2026-10-13. No 2027 dates, prices or themes have been posted yet.
Prices depend on museum membership: $290/week for members and $325/week for non-members. Session prices and price_per_week use the non-member rate.
Extended hour until 5 pm costs an extra $50/week.
The registration link is a Google Form for 2026 Week One only, so it may not work for future seasons.
Camp meets at two sites: Mon/Wed/Fri at the Noah Webster House (227 South Main St) and Tue/Thu at Westmoor Park (119 Flagg Road, West Hartford).
Camp hours are 8:30 a.m. to 4 p.m.
The page lists two phone numbers: 860-502-3247 for the education staff (camp questions) and 860.521.5362 for the museum's main line.
